lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਪਥਰ ਤਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paap pathar taran na jaaee ||
lines.translation: Sin is a stone which does not float.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉ ਬੇੜਾ ਜੀਉ ਚੜਾਊ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhau beRaa jeeu chaRaaoo ||
lines.translation: So let the Fear of God be the boat to carry your soul across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਾਹੂ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kahu naanak devai kaahoo ||4||2||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, rare are those who are blessed with this Boat. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਦੁਇ ਲੇਖ ਪਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: karanee kaagad man masavaanee buraa bhalaa dui lekh pae ||
lines.translation: Actions are the paper, and the mind is the ink; good and bad are both recorded upon it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਚਲੀਐ ਤਉ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤੁ ਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jiu kirat chalaae tiu chaleeai tau gun naahee a(n)t hare ||1||
lines.translation: As their past actions drive them, so are mortals driven. There is no end to Your Glorious Virtues, Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤਸਿ ਕੀ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਵਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chit chetas kee nahee baavariaa ||
lines.translation: Why do you not keep Him in your consciousness, you mad man?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bisarat tere gun galiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Lord, your own virtues shall rot away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਲੀ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਾਲੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਹੂਆ ਜੇਤੀ ਘੜੀ ਫਾਹੀ ਤੇਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaalee rain jaal din hooaa jetee ghaRee phaahee tetee ||
lines.translation: The night is a net, and the day is a net; there are as many traps as there are moments.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਫਾਸਹਿ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ras ras chog chugahi nit phaasahi chhootas mooRe kavan gunee ||2||
lines.translation: With relish and delight, you continually bite at the bait; you are trapped, you fool - how will you ever escape? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਆਰਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਲੋਹਾ ਪੰਚ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa aaran man vich lohaa pa(n)ch agan tit laag rahee ||
lines.translation: The body is a furnace, and the mind is the iron within it; the five fires are heating it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਇਲੇ ਪਾਪ ਪੜੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਲਿਆ ਸੰਨੑੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਭਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: koile paap paRe tis oopar man jaliaa sa(n)nhee chi(n)t bhaee ||3||
lines.translation: Sin is the charcoal placed upon it, which burns the mind; the tongs are anxiety and worry. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਆ ਮਨੂਰੁ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਨੇਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaiaa manoor ka(n)chan phir hovai je gur milai tinehaa ||
lines.translation: What was turned to slag is again transformed into gold, if one meets with the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਓਹੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟਸਿ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ek naam a(n)mrit ohu devai tau naanak trisatas dehaa ||4||3||
lines.translation: He blesses the mortal with the Ambrosial Name of the One Lord, and then, O Nanak, the body is held steady. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਮਲ ਮਝਾਰਿ ਬਸਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਪਦਮਨਿ ਜਾਵਲ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bimal majhaar basas niramal jal padaman jaaval re ||
lines.translation: In the pure, immaculate waters, both the lotus and the slimy scum are found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਦਮਨਿ ਜਾਵਲ ਜਲ ਰਸ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਦੋਖ ਨਹੀ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: padaman jaaval jal ras sa(n)gat sa(n)g dokh nahee re ||1||
lines.translation: The lotus flower is with the scum and the water, but it remains untouched by any pollution. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਦਰ ਤੂ ਕਬਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਸਿ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: daadar too kabahi na jaanas re ||
lines.translation: You frog, you will never understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਖਸਿ ਸਿਬਾਲੁ ਬਸਸਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਖਸਿ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhakhas sibaal basas niramal jal a(n)mrit na lakhas re ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You eat the dirt, while you dwell in the immaculate waters. You know nothing of the ambrosial nectar there. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੁ ਜਲ ਨਿਤ ਨ ਵਸਤ ਅਲੀਅਲ ਮੇਰ ਚਚਾ ਗੁਨ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bas jal nit na vasat aleeal mer chachaa gun re ||
lines.translation: You dwell continually in the water; the bumble bee does not dwell there, but it is intoxicated with its fragrance from afar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦ ਕੁਮੁਦਨੀ ਦੂਰਹੁ ਨਿਵਸਸਿ ਅਨਭਉ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)d kumudanee doorahu nivasas anabhau kaaran re ||2||
lines.translation: Intuitively sensing the moon in the distance, the lotus bows its head. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਖੰਡੁ ਦੂਧਿ ਮਧੁ ਸੰਚਸਿ ਤੂ ਬਨ ਚਾਤੁਰ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit kha(n)d doodh madh sa(n)chas too ban chaatur re ||
lines.translation: The realms of nectar are irrigated with milk and honey; you think you are clever to live in the water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਸਿ ਪਿਸਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਉ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: apanaa aap too kabahu na chhodas pisan preet jiu re ||3||
lines.translation: You can never escape your own inner tendencies, like the love of the flea for blood. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸੰਗਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਜਨ ਮੂਰਖ ਆਗਮ ਸਾਸ ਸੁਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit sa(n)g vasahi jan moorakh aagam saas sune ||
lines.translation: The fool may live with the Pandit, the religious scholar, and listen to the Vedas and the Shaastras.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨਾ ਆਪੁ ਤੂ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਸਿ ਸੁਆਨ ਪੂਛਿ ਜਿਉ ਰੇ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: apanaa aap too kabahu na chhodas suaan poochh jiu re ||4||
lines.translation: You can never escape your own inner tendencies, like the crooked tail of the dog. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਰਾਚਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik paakha(n)dee naam na raachahi ik har har charanee re ||
lines.translation: Some are hypocrites; they do not merge with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Some are absorbed in the Feet of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਵਸਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਰੇ ॥੫॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: poorab likhiaa paavas naanak rasanaa naam jap re ||5||4||
lines.translation: The mortals obtain what they are predestined to receive; O Nanak, with your tongue, chant the Naam. ||5||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, First Mehl,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਅਸੰਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit puneet asa(n)kh hohi har charanee man laag ||
lines.translation: Countless sinners are sanctified, attaching their minds to the Feet of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: athasath teerath naam prabh naanak jis masatak bhaag ||1||
lines.translation: The merits of the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage are found in God's Name, O Nanak, when such destiny is inscribed upon one's forehead. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad ||
lines.translation: Shabad:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਹੇਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakhee sahelee garab gahelee ||
lines.translation: O friends and companions, so puffed up with pride,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਇਕ ਬਾਤ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sun sah kee ik baat suhelee ||1||
lines.translation: listen to this one joyous story of your Husband Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮੈ ਬੇਦਨ ਸਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਆਖਾ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo mai bedan saa kis aakhaa maaee ||
lines.translation: Who can I tell about my pain, O my mother?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਉ ਨ ਰਹੈ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਾਖਾ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin jeeu na rahai kaise raakhaa maaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, my soul cannot survive; how can I comfort it, O my mother? ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਖਰੀ ਰੰਞਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau dohaagan kharee ra(n)njaanee ||
lines.translation: I am a dejected, discarded bride, totally miserable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਇਆ ਸੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨ ਪਛੁਤਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gaiaa s joban dhan pachhutaanee ||2||
lines.translation: I have lost my youth; I regret and repent. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too daanaa saahib sir meraa ||
lines.translation: You are my wise Lord and Master, above my head.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਜਮਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਜਨੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: khijamat karee jan ba(n)daa teraa ||3||
lines.translation: I serve You as Your humble slave. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਏਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak a(n)desaa ehee ||
lines.translation: Nanak humbly prays, this is my only concern:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈਸੇ ਰਵਉ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: bin darasan kaise ravau sanehee ||4||5||
lines.translation: without the Blessed Vision of my Beloved, how can I enjoy Him? ||4||5||
